parent_result: design/BRad-RQ.json (v2) and its run: 170 distinct three-token SIDs, 12 / 5 / 3 active codes at levels 1-3, L3 collision 1.0, training loss 1.6e-05
why_a_new_version: Version 2 optimised a reconstruction of the model's own latent, and that target has a degenerate minimum: the encoder may compress every item into a few directions, the codebook collapses, and the loss falls anyway. Version 3 keeps the mechanism's core -- the behaviour statistic sets the hyperbolic radius of the item point, the code is the nearest codeword under the Poincare kernel at every level, training and export agree -- and changes only what the collapse exposed: the reconstruction target, the initialisation, and what happens to a code nobody chooses. It is a new candidate tree built from the frozen baseline, not an edit of the v2 result.

behaviour_statistic.source: consecutive item pairs inside training sessions only
behaviour_statistic.statistic: s_i = exp(H_i), the effective number of distinct predecessor contexts
behaviour_statistic.shrinkage: 1/(n_i+1) towards the mean over items with n_i >= 10
behaviour_statistic.frozen: computed once before epoch 1, stored as a model buffer

radius.rank_set: the items with at least one training transition; catalogue items outside it are not ranked and take the median radius
radius.tangent_target: t_i = r_i * z_i / |z_i| with z_i = Encoder(x_i), differentiable in z_i

reconstruction.rule: L = MSE(Decoder(t_hat), x_i) + [MSE(x_q, sg(t)) + beta * MSE(t, sg(x_q))]
reconstruction.target: x_i, the ORIGINAL Stage1 embedding -- a target the encoder does not produce
reconstruction.why: a reconstruction of the model's own latent can be driven to zero while the identifier loses all information; the external target cannot
reconstruction.decoder: trained, not frozen: it receives a real gradient through t_hat
reconstruction.beta: the baseline value 0.25; no new weight is introduced

assignment.rule: k_l = argmin_k S(a_l, e_{l,k}) at every level, in training, initialisation and export
assignment.geometry_on: a_l = exp_0(t_l / M_l) and S is the Poincare kernel on the mapped points
assignment.sinkhorn: never on the radial path; the baseline's balancing is not inherited
assignment.residual: r_{l+1} = the level's input minus the chosen code, re-scaled by M_{l+1}

initialisation.rule: the radii are bound BEFORE the codebooks are built, and KMeans runs on the behaviour-scaled tangent the quantizer scores
initialisation.per_level: levels 2 and 3 receive the residual formed by the real assignment rule, not by a Euclidean argmin
initialisation.small_sample: fewer items than codes: the items seed the centres and the remainder starts at their mean with a fixed tiny offset, deterministically

dead_code_recovery.rule: a code unused for DEAD_CODE_PATIENCE consecutive checks is re-seeded from the worst-quantised items, in descending error order
dead_code_recovery.patience: 20 checks of 10 epochs (a code unused for 200 of 3000 epochs has no realistic chance of being used later)
dead_code_recovery.budget: at most one code per available item is re-seeded in one pass; the rest keep their streak
dead_code_recovery.optimizer: the AdamW moments of a re-seeded code are cleared
dead_code_recovery.determinism: the item order is by descending error with ties broken by index; the policy is fixed before training and is not tuned against any score

geometry_off.rule: the exponential map is the identity and S is the squared Euclidean distance on the tangent vectors, with the behaviour radius still applied
geometry_off.why: the ablation isolates the curvature; the radius, the assignment rule, the reconstruction target and the loss are unchanged

behaviour_off.rule: every item gets the median radius; everything else is unchanged

both_on.rule: measured radii, curvature on, nearest-codeword assignment, original-embedding reconstruction, dead-code recovery
both_on.training_policy: this is the only arm that is trained (section 19g); the two switches exist in the code and are checked by tests

recorded_every_epoch: reconstruction MSE against the original embedding
diagnostics.policy: recorded, never a Stage 2 admission gate

inertness_conditions: if the radius table never reaches the quantizer, the mechanism is inert
if the assignment ignores the mapped point, the radius cannot change a single code
if the reconstruction target is a vector the encoder produces, the collapse can return
if the codebook is initialised before the radii are bound, it starts where the training never quantises
if training and export use different assignment rules, the exported identifier is not the code the trained quantizer assigns
if a code is never re-seeded, capacity is lost silently

acceptance.tests: each rule above has a test that calls the real functions, including the anti-degeneracy test: two items with one quantised point cannot both be reconstructed
acceptance.verification: the V2 record names this contract's version and sha256
acceptance.final: Stage 3 test_recall@10 from the single frozen run, compared with the baseline 0.055537 and the target 0.065
